flows.title: Upload files
steps: On onedrive.com, browse to the location to add the files.
Select the files to upload, then select Open.

flows.title: Share a file or folder with people
steps: Select the file or folder's circle icon, then select Share at the top of the page.
To change who the link works for, select the settings gear icon, choose the settings, and select Apply.
In the Name, group or email field, start typing the email addresses or contact names of the people to share with.
Include a message if you want, then select Send.

flows.title: Move a file or folder
steps: Browse to the file or folder to move.
Select it by checking its circle. Several items can be selected and moved together.
In the top navigation, select Move to.
In the Move to pane, browse to the destination folder and select Move. Select New folder to create one to move it into.
